book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: QꞌU KAM IBꞌAXABꞌSA IKꞌUCHAXU TIOXH TU U XHAN (Apocalipsis) U uꞌuj uvaꞌ Apocalipsis uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Xhun

content: Niyolon u Xhun tiꞌ umaꞌl u ixoj tukꞌ umaꞌt u nimla txꞌiꞌlatxoo

As ilax veꞌt umaꞌl u vaaꞌ tu almikaꞌ. As aꞌ umaꞌl u ixoj uvaꞌ ech u toksaꞌmeꞌ echeꞌ u qꞌiieꞌ. As atik kan u ichꞌeꞌ jaqꞌ toj u ixojeꞌ. As atik jeꞌ umaꞌl u koroona tiꞌ iviꞌ ixoj uvaꞌ atik ok kabꞌlaval unqꞌa txꞌumileꞌ stiꞌ.
As atik veꞌt iyaabꞌil ixoj tiꞌ talaj intxaꞌ. As vaꞌlik chit isikꞌin veꞌt ixoj taꞌn u chꞌoꞌmeꞌ uveꞌ nik ipalebꞌe veꞌt ixoj, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ tuk alanoj veꞌt ixoj.
As ikꞌuch veꞌt tibꞌ umaꞌte tu almikaꞌ. As aꞌ umaꞌl u nimla txoo uvaꞌ kaj chit tiꞌ. As vujvaꞌl iviꞌ txoo atike. As laval tukꞌ txoo atike. As atik jeꞌ umaꞌl u koroona tiꞌ junun unqꞌa iviꞌ txooeꞌ.

As pal teesa veꞌt vijee txooeꞌ chꞌoola pokꞌoꞌchil unqꞌa txꞌumileꞌ vatz u almikaꞌeꞌ. As chajpik veꞌt tzan unqꞌa txꞌumileꞌ vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ taꞌn txoo. As txakebꞌ veꞌt txoo vatz u ixojeꞌ uvaꞌ tuk alanoj veꞌteꞌ, tan aꞌ nik tal txoo uvaꞌ la ichiꞌ veꞌt txoo u tal ixojeꞌ uvaꞌ la itzꞌebꞌi.

As alan veꞌt ixoj. As xaak u tal neꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ kat itzꞌebꞌi. As aꞌ veꞌteꞌ la ok veꞌt ijlenaalil tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil tukꞌ umaꞌl vibꞌaara uvaꞌ chꞌichꞌ. As maap veꞌt u tal u ixojeꞌ vatz u txooeꞌ. As eqꞌol veꞌt jeꞌ vatz u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ as vatz vinimla xonlebꞌal Aakeꞌ.
As ooj veꞌt ixoj vatz u txooeꞌ. As oon veꞌt ixoj tu umaꞌl u tzuukin txꞌavaꞌ, tan maꞌtik ibꞌanat u Tiixheꞌ tuch tatinbꞌal ixoj tiꞌ uvaꞌ la kolax veꞌt ixoj tu umaꞌl mil oxlaval kꞌalal (1,260) qꞌii.
As xeꞌt veꞌt umaꞌl u mam chꞌaꞌo tu almikaꞌ. As iqꞌos veꞌt tibꞌ unqꞌa ángel uvaꞌ echen kꞌatz u ángel uvaꞌ Meꞌk ibꞌii tukꞌ u nimla txꞌiꞌlatxooeꞌ as tukꞌ unqꞌa ángel uvaꞌ xekel tiꞌ u txooeꞌ.
As yeꞌ kat olebꞌ veꞌt u nimla txꞌiꞌlatxooeꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa imooleꞌ tiꞌ u Meꞌkeꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa ángel uvaꞌ xekel stiꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ yeꞌ kat uch tatin u nimla txꞌiꞌlatxooeꞌ tu almikaꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa imooleꞌ.

As kat eesal veꞌt el tzan u nimla txꞌiꞌlatxooeꞌ tu almikaꞌ. As kat sutil veꞌt kuꞌ tzan vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa imooleꞌ. As u nimla txꞌiꞌlatxooeꞌ as aꞌeꞌ u txꞌiꞌlatxooeꞌ uvaꞌ at chittuꞌ uvaꞌ txꞌiꞌlanaj chꞌelel as Satanás unpajte. As aꞌeꞌ ni eesan unqꞌa tenameꞌ tu bꞌey.
As vabꞌi veꞌt umaꞌl u tuul viꞌ uvaꞌ saqꞌchibꞌal chittuꞌ tu almikaꞌ. As ech tal ileꞌ:

content.text: As kat sutilyak veꞌt bꞌeneꞌ el u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ uvaꞌ ni cheesan ipaav unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ vatz u Tiixheꞌ sqꞌiil aqꞌbꞌal.
As kat eesaliy veꞌt u paaveꞌ tiꞌ vitenam u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ chit ibꞌeneꞌ
As ni xeꞌt veꞌt u Tiixheꞌ tukꞌ u tijleꞌmeꞌ, as tukꞌ viyakꞌileꞌ, as tukꞌ u tijleꞌm u Cristo.

content: As tukꞌ vikajal u Kaneeroꞌeꞌ, as tukꞌ ibꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ, as tiꞌ taqꞌat chajaak vitiichajileꞌ kamoj tiꞌ ibꞌanat kanal.
¡As chiibꞌojtaj ex, jankꞌal ex uvaꞌ at ex tu almikaꞌ!

content.text: ¡Pet oyebꞌ chit evatz, ex uveꞌ at ex vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa veeꞌ at xeꞌ u mar!
Tan kat kuꞌyak veꞌt chꞌuꞌl u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ sexoꞌl.
As at skꞌuꞌl u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌiit kuxh ilejat veꞌt viqꞌiieꞌ tiꞌ isotzeꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ kat txꞌiꞌtziꞌltu veꞌt u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ setiꞌ, tiꞌk u tuul viꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ vabꞌi.

content: As tul kat til veꞌt u nimla txꞌiꞌlatxooeꞌ uvaꞌ maꞌt isutil kuꞌ tzan txoo vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, as xeꞌt veꞌt txoo tiꞌ itilul u ixojeꞌ uvaꞌ kat alan u tal xaakeꞌ.

As aqꞌax veꞌt kaꞌvaꞌl ixichꞌ u ixojeꞌ echeꞌ ixichꞌ umaj nimla xichꞌ, tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ooj veꞌt ixoj vatz u txooeꞌ. As la xichꞌan veꞌt ibꞌen ixoj tu u tatinbꞌaleꞌ tu u tzuukin txꞌavaꞌeꞌ tu uveꞌ la kolpukat ixoj tu oxvaꞌl yaabꞌ tukꞌ vaajit ichꞌ.
As ixaꞌva veꞌt bꞌen txoo mamaꞌla aꞌ tiꞌ u ixojeꞌ uvaꞌ ech veꞌteꞌ echeꞌ nimla aꞌ ibꞌana. As la tija veꞌt u aꞌeꞌ u ixojeꞌ skꞌuꞌl.
Pet kat iloch veꞌt u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ u ixojeꞌ, tan ijaj veꞌt tibꞌ u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ. As bꞌen veꞌt u nimla aꞌeꞌ tu u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ ixaꞌva u nimla txꞌiꞌlatxooeꞌ.

As aal chit ul veꞌt iviꞌ u nimla txꞌiꞌlatxooeꞌ tiꞌ u ixojeꞌ. As bꞌex ixeꞌtisa veꞌt txoo chꞌaꞌo tiꞌ unjoltu unqꞌa tal u ixojeꞌ uvaꞌ nikat niman veꞌt u tzaqꞌiteꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan. As yeꞌ kat teesa tibꞌ tiꞌ inimat viyol u Jesúseꞌ.
